name: ScrollSentry
description: Block distracting sites, interrupt endless scrolling, and make your browsing more deliberate.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: http: https:; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://scroll-sentry-serverless.maverick-apps.workers.dev http://localhost:8787 http://127.0.0.1:8787; frame-src 'self' https://scroll-sentry-serverless.maverick-apps.workers.dev http://localhost:8787 http://127.0.0.1:8787;
